labels.name: Flexor retinaculum
labels.function: Fibrous roof that holds the long tendons close to the wrist

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Compressed here: numb lateral 3½ digits, weak thumb opposition

labels.name: Flexor digitorum superficialis tendons
labels.function: Superficial row of four; bend the PIP joints of digits 2-5

labels.name: Flexor digitorum profundus tendons
labels.function: Deep row of four; bend the DIP joints of digits 2-5

labels.name: Flexor pollicis longus tendon
labels.function: Single thumb tendon in the tunnel; bends the distal thumb phalanx

labels.name: Flexor carpi radialis tendon
labels.function: Wrist tendon in its own sheath, NOT inside the tunnel

labels.name: Ulnar artery
labels.function: Vessel entering the hand superficial to the roof

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Passes in Guyon's canal; supplies most intrinsic hand muscles

labels.name: Carpal bones
labels.function: Bony floor and walls of the tunnel

labels.name: Radius
labels.function: Bone that turns over its partner to rotate the palm; Colles site

labels.name: Ulna
labels.function: Relatively stationary forearm bone: the axis of rotation

labels.name: Distal radioulnar joint
labels.function: Distal pivot of pronation and supination

labels.name: Radiocarpal joint
labels.function: Condyloid joint: flex/extend, radial/ulnar deviation, circumduction

labels.name: Scaphoid
labels.function: Snuffbox-tender after FOOSH; poor proximal supply risks AVN

labels.name: Trapezium
labels.function: Distal-row carpal bearing the thumb's metacarpal

labels.name: First carpometacarpal joint
labels.function: Saddle joint enabling opposition; common osteoarthritis site

labels.name: Metacarpophalangeal joint
labels.function: Knuckle joint joining a metacarpal to a proximal phalanx

labels.name: Proximal interphalangeal joint
labels.function: Middle finger-joint bent by the superficial long flexor

labels.name: Distal interphalangeal joint
labels.function: Fingertip joint bent only by the deep long flexor

labels.name: Thenar muscles
labels.function: Oppose and abduct the thumb; waste in chronic carpal tunnel compression

labels.name: Hypothenar muscles
labels.function: Move the little finger and help cup the hand

labels.name: Adductor pollicis
labels.function: Pulls the thumb toward the palm; ulnar-supplied, not thenar

labels.name: Lumbricals
labels.function: Bend MCP and straighten IP joints via the extensor hood

labels.name: Interossei
labels.function: Spread (DAB) and close (PAD) the digits about the 3rd digit

labels.name: Recurrent branch of median nerve
labels.function: Superficial motor twig: cut it and opposition fails, skin spared

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Skin of lateral palm and lateral 3½ digits (palmar side)

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Supplies most intrinsics; injury gives claw of digits 4-5
